My plan is use this space to write:

- Short summaries and reviews of topical infection papers I find interesting, and I think might be clinically relevant
- Maybe occasional longer pieces on epidemiology and disease dynamics

If anyone reading this would like to join me in writing, that would be amazing. 
You can either email me the summary and I'll publish it or there are some instructions on how you can do it directly with Quarto in the [README](https://github.com/jackwgoodall/jackwgoodall.github.io/blob/781ba5f8b4cbd64f270e14c9da8beb4fa16458f8/README.md)
